usage: cox setup doctor [-h] [--profile PROFILE] [--repo REPO] [--json] [--host HOST]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
  --repo REPO        target repo to check for a .agent/cartridge.yaml overlay (default: cwd)
  --json
  --host HOST        run the doctor on this lane host from lane_hosts; --json is ignored
